name: CALF-20 80/20 shaped source-transfer

evidence.basis: 80 wt% CALF-20 crystal and 20 wt% polymeric binder, with published author-site parameters and shaped water measurements
evidence.not_for: universal humid coadsorption, lifetime, powder-to-shape transfer, annual output or measured device ranking

shaped_material.basis: Complete dry shaped material containing 80 wt% crystals and 20 wt% binder
shaped_material.binder_support: 20 wt% polymeric binder as named in the source-transfer scenario
shaped_material.particle_geometry: Case input; no transfer to a specific pellet or coating is established.

co2.source_locator: Nguyen et al. supporting information pS6 Eq and Table S2

water.source_locator: Nguyen et al. supporting information pS8 Table S4, 22 C block
water.basis: temperature-activity transfer of the published shaped-material unary water curve

kinetics.evidence_status: shared illustrative LDF assumptions for both source sites and water

assumptions: The two published concentration-basis sites are retained independently; CALF is not refit as one Langmuir site.
Site internal energies define the CO2 energy inventory exactly.
Water uses a named single-temperature PCHIP activity transfer with a borrowed sorption heat.
LDF kinetics and pellet or coating transfer remain unvalidated.

validity.water: The water table is unary and temperature-shifted; it is not a validated competitive humid-mixture model.
validity.initial_state_interpretation: Initial loading is a declared screening basis and does not establish cyclic steady state.

uncertainty.statement: No transferred uncertainty distribution or measured shaped-device error exists in this package.
